intro:
Canadian visas are applied for online and decided on paper, without an interview. Everything depends on how convincing the application is — finances, purpose of travel, ties to home and the cover letter.

We handle the entire application: from creating the account to uploading documents and booking biometrics.
services: Creating and managing your IRCC account
Study Permit for students: acceptance letter, funds, study plan

sections.heading: Why the letter of explanation matters
sections.body: The officer never meets you — they only see documents. A well-written letter ties the documents into one story: why you are travelling, who pays and why you will return. We write it in English based on your documents.

documents: For study: Letter of Acceptance and proof of funds

steps.title: Biometrics and decision
steps.text: We book biometrics and track the application status.

faq.a: No, the decision is based on documents. You only need to give biometrics (fingerprints and photo) in person at a visa centre.
Times change and depend on the country and application type. Current times are published on the Government of Canada website — we check them before applying.

faq.q: Can I apply for study and a visitor visa at the same time?
faq.a: They are separate applications with different purposes. We will advise which one fits your situation.
